name: Echo first working product ready for review
instruction: A TaskFlow progress comment for the Echo agent-harness build task.

content.body: First working product is ready for review. Main now includes a runnable `agent-harness serve` CLI, FastAPI service, v1 sessions/runs/messages/backends endpoints, firehose/session/run SSE stream endpoints, in-memory event bus/repository, watchfiles-backed transcript watch service, observer materialization into repository state, and OpenAPI/hybrid docs. Verification: uv run pytest -> 27 passed; OpenAPI YAML parses; smoke test served on 127.0.0.1:8876 and returned 200 for /health and /v1/backends. Latest commit: 665ebb7.
